scientific_queries.note: Replication test of the previous round's positive claim on 21 layouts with a permutation null.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round's own retest is the challenge.

retraction.claim: C16 (shared annotated target -> more cross-cell order instability, +1.76 pp)
retraction.reason: sign reverses on 21 layouts; only 38% of layouts positive; observed value sits in the negative tail of the gene-label permutation null
retraction.mechanism_of_the_original_error: the inclusion rule '>=3 QC-passing cells' left only 2 layouts, and those two are the most positive of the 21; selecting on cell count selected on a variable correlated with the effect

not_concluded: the pooled negative direction is NOT attributed to target overlap: the two groups also differ in separation (+0.0099) in the same direction as the outcome
methodological_constraint_added: target-conditional analyses need >=6 independent layouts and must not select layouts on a variable correlated with the effect (such as cell count)

register_updates.F6: correction retained - annotation-level target reference does exist (67.8% of compounds)
